excerpts.title: Initiate Job Rework
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: available. Authorized business writers can create Rework for a completed Production Job. Open the Job in Production and select Create Rework. Choose a Reason, describe Rework Scope / Work Required, enter Intake / Return Date, then select Create Rework. The Job must be complete, unarchived and have no active Rework cycle. Only one Rework cycle can be active at a time. Rework remains on the same canonical Job and preserves original Production status and dates. Scope is a whole-Job description, not structured piece or Color Plate tracking.

excerpts.title: Filter Manpower Reporting by Job
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: available. Employees with business-write access can filter labor by Production Job. Open Reporting → Manpower Reporting, then choose the Job in Job labor review. Use Clear job filter or All reporting groups to reset. After selecting a Job, Product Category filter narrows products. Analytics use the selected reporting period; reporting rows are loaded complete groups with all their dates. Search and filters are not exhaustive until all available history is loaded. Read-only accounts cannot change the current Job labor review selector, but can use Search manpower or open a Job’s Current Hours link from Production.

raw.answer: To initiate a rework for a job, open the job in Production, select Create Rework, choose a reason, describe the rework scope, enter the intake/return date, and select Create Rework. To filter by jobs in manpower reporting, open Reporting > Manpower Reporting, choose the job in Job labor review, and use the Clear job filter or All reporting groups to reset. Then, select a job and use the Product Category filter to narrow products.

excerpts.title: Edit a saved customer’s details
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: available. Open Toolbox → Resources → Contacts. Search for the beginning of the customer’s company name, then select the company name to open Customer Inspector. Edit Customer / Company Name, or expand Additional Information (Optional) to edit Contact Name, Phone Number or Email Address. Choose Save Changes. Lead/Admin access is required to edit a saved customer; read-only accounts cannot save changes. Saved changes apply to future selections. Existing Jobs and Proposals keep their captured information.

excerpts.title: Create a group conversation
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: available. Open Messaging from the app header. Choose New group, enter a group name, select at least one other participant, then choose Create group. Only the creator can rename the group or add/remove participants. Current members share the full history; removed members lose access. Previously signed attachment links may remain usable for up to ten minutes.
